COD.note: Responsible AI is only an axis of a draft policy; no AI rule or authority stated.
Nothing on AI used by a government body.
Nothing on AI in a sector system.
Nothing on AI built or hosted in the country.
The PSEN is the digital economy ministry's sector policy; no cabinet adoption as a national strategy stated.

facts.fact: A technical validation workshop in Kinshasa on 21-22 July 2026 validated the draft Politique sectorielle de l'économie numérique (PSEN) 2026-2030, subject to amendments, ahead of final adoption.
The draft PSEN covers 2026-2030, led by the Ministry of Digital Economy with UNDP technical and financial support.
The digital economy ministry's 21-22 July 2026 validation workshop on the draft PSEN 2026-2030 brought together private sector, academics and civil society alongside officials and partners.
